text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond is watching the Japan Cup, and she's blown away by how aggressively Tokai Teio and Kitasan Black run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio says that she always strives to take on new challenges. If she were to ever stop challenging herself, that would spell her end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After hearing that, Satono Diamond decides that she also wants to keep being a challenger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to take on any challenge and open a new chapter of history for both the Umamusume world and the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That is Satono Diamond's way of being an illustrious runner.
